description: The least common multiple of the integers from lo through hi. The LCM of 1 through 10 is 2520, and the LCM of 1 through 11 is 27720. lo must not pass hi. Each end runs from 1 to 40. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/range-lcm
